subject: Commercial onramp: MAP milestones, ramp schedule & invoicing cadence
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@acornhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial onramp: MAP milestones, ramp schedule & invoicing cadence

Hi Elena —

Great to meet last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that ties technical milestones to commercial checkpoints so we can align evaluation success criteria with the procurement timeline.

High-level proposal:
- Evaluation phase (2-3 weeks): proof-of-concept access to 2 dedicated instances, limited token quota for evaluation. Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for sample workload, qualitative accuracy on 5 representative prompts.
- Commercial ramp (30–60 days): pilot => production ramp with committed throughput tiers and per-token pricing tiers.
- Billing & PO: billing start tied to first paid invoice after PO acceptance; standard Net30, Net60 available for enterprise; option to backdate billing to production go-live with a one-time credit for evaluation tokens.

Attached: Acorn_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP with milestone dates) and SOW_Draft.docx (workload assumptions). I cc'd Lauren (solutions) and Monica (finance) so we can surface procurement and milestone-based invoicing options.

Two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm procurement lead/email and whether Acorn requires a PO before the first invoice?
2) Would Net60 be required, or is Net30 acceptable for this pilot?

Happy to go through the MAP in a short call — I can share screen and walk the milestones.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Acorn_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 12 pages), SOW_Draft.docx (DOCX, 3 pages)
From: Elena Park <elena@acornhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Boone <mboone@acornhealth.com>, procurement@acornhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: MAP milestones, ramp schedule & invoicing cadence

Thanks, Sergio — this looks promising. A couple quick notes from Acorn side:
- Procurement: yes, we require a PO for any paid engagement. I looped procurement on this thread (procurement@acornhealth.com).
- Payment terms: our standard is Net60 for initial vendors; we can consider Net30 for strategic partners but need exec approval.
- Billing start: we prefer billing to start on the first day of production traffic (not during evaluation). If Redwood can provide a one-time evaluation credit or a prorated invoice we can be flexible.

Can your finance/legal team confirm whether Redwood is able to:
1) Accept a PO prior to invoice issuance and attach a Master Services Agreement (MSA) and SOW?
2) Offer Net60 as the default with the option to move to Net30 post exec approval?

I'll do internal check on timeline — Michael will own scheduling the pilot.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Product Operations | Acorn Health
elena@acornhealth.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: procurement@acornhealth.com, Elena Park <elena@acornhealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: MAP milestones, ramp schedule & invoicing cadence

Hi Elena / Acorn procurement team —

Thanks for the quick head's up. A few clarifications from finance:
- We can accept a PO prior to the first invoice. Standard flow: customer issues PO referencing the SOW and MSA, Redwood generates invoice referencing PO number.
- For billing start: we typically start invoicing on the effective date specified in the SOW. If Acorn wants billing to start on production go-live, we can put that date in the SOW and issue the first invoice after acceptance.
- Net terms: Net30 is our default. Net60 is available for enterprise customers with a signed credit application and references — it can be set as a field in the billing profile.

Proposed compromise to keep momentum:
- Put Net60 as the billing terms in the draft SOW and invoice profile; if Acorn secures exec approval for Net30 within 60 days we will apply a one-time invoice adjustment/credit to reflect the agreed terms going forward.
- We can also issue an evaluation credit (one-time) equivalent to X tokens to offset evaluation usage if you prefer billing start to be production-only.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with procurement to confirm PO language and required billing fields.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: procurement@acornhealth.com
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@acornhealth.com>, Michael Boone <mboone@acornhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: MAP milestones, ramp schedule & invoicing cadence

Hi Monica / Sergio —

Thanks for the details. Procurement requirements at a glance:
- PO required and must include: PO number, billing contact, shipping address (n/a), remit-to address for Redwood, and reference to SOW/MSA.
- Payment terms: Net60 is our starting position; contingent on Redwood providing standard W-9 and completed vendor onboarding form (attached).
- Invoicing cadence: monthly in arrears preferred. If Redwood invoices at milestone triggers instead, we need milestone definitions in SOW with acceptance criteria.

We attached our vendor_onboard_form.pdf — please confirm Redwood's remit-to address and VAT/tax details for the invoice. Once vendor onboarding is complete we will issue PO.

Procurement Team
Acorn Health
procurement@acornhealth.com
Attachment: vendor_onboard_form.pdf
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@acornhealth.com>, procurement@acornhealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onramp: MAP milestones, ramp schedule & invoicing cadence

All —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Next steps I suggest to keep the close on track:
1) Redwood sends updated SOW and MSA with: billing start = production go-live date, clear milestone acceptance language (PO-based invoicing or monthly arrears), and Net60 pre-populated with an option to move to Net30 upon exec approval. (Monica / Markus to draft.)
2) Acorn procurement completes vendor_onboard_form and returns W-9. Once we have that, Redwood will provide remit-to and tax info to be referenced on the PO.
3) For evaluation tokens: Redwood will issue a one-time evaluation credit of up to 50k tokens to be applied against the first invoice as a line item credit if billing starts on production.
4) Target: SOW/MSA back to Acorn by EOD Friday (2027-04-16). If accepted, procurement issues PO and we target pilot start 2027-05-03.

If that schedule works, Monica will send the contract redlines and SOW with the requested fields, and Lauren will schedule a 30-min kickoff to walk the MAP milestones with Michael.

Appreciate the partnership — we're excited to get the pilot started.

Best,
Sergio
